summary: The AlignSynch rail is five sections — Start, Operations, Content & configuration, Specs & docs, Member — with the admin landing and four docs/spec surfaces as rows; no route was added, removed, renamed or redirected.
reader_impact: An administrator's rail now opens on the admin landing and groups the six surfaces one operator uses together, while a member still sees the same six `/dashboard/*` rows under one section instead of two.
